metadata.name: HTTPS_PROXY in graph config (override env)
metadata.description: Demonstrates setting the transport proxy inside graph.json via the agent block's `https_proxy` key. The configured proxy OVERRIDES any HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY from the environment — the pipeline pins its own egress proxy (here: local Clash 127.0.1.6:7890).
